items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: What was the difference between the music Buddy Bolden's band played and the Rubbish Olds band played? ... No, no, they were all a lot different.

ctx.x: Yeah. He didn't know you used to play around the band. I was like, fuck, they used to play all over. You were going to just play. Mm-hmm. But they used to play all of the little halls downtown. They had better little halls, little clubs and things all downtown. What was the difference between the music Buddy Bolden's band played and the Rubbish Olds band played? Were they almost the same or... No, no, they were all a lot different. All rough different. No, no, no. They were all a lot different. The Rubbish Olds…

Would the same club hire the two different bands ever? Huh? Would they hire the two bands... The same club, the same society has the two different bands. Not at the same time. Not at the same type of band. No.
